feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 8:30am
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain, becoming persistent and heavy at times through the day and continuing into the night. Winds will be a strong to gale force south-easterly gradually decreasing later. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Gales in the morning/early afternoon. Coastal overtopping around the times of high tide (~10:30am and ~11pm). Risk of localised flooding due to heavy rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

15-30


##Wind Speed##

28


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 25-30, increasing 30-35 with gusts 40-45 in exposed spots this morning, then gradually decreasing 20-25.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Patchy outbreaks of rain at first on Wednesday soon clearing to become dry and largely cloudy for the rest of the day. Fresh to strong southeast wind becoming a moderate to fresh east or southeast later. Highest temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds until later. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide (~11:15am and ~11:45pm)


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 20-25, soon decreasing 15-20, backing east or southeast later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Thursday, 26 November 2026##

Dry at first and during the daytime on Thursday with variable amounts of cloud. Cloud then thickening later with a few outbreaks of rain arriving early in the night. Moderate to fresh southeast winds increasing strong later, top temperature 7°C. Comments: Strong winds soon developing. Risk of gales in exposed spots later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 7°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-3


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

East or southeast 15-20, soon increasing southeast 20-25, then 25-32 later in the evening with the risk of 35 and gusts up to 45 in places later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain later. Patchy hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 27 November 2026##

Outbreaks of rain through the morning, then becoming dry with some sunny/clear intervals developing through the afternoon. Strong southeast wind at first soon easing to become light to moderate and a top temperature of 8°C. Comments: Risk of gales at first, then strong winds. Risk of heavy rain at first.


##Temperature##

##Visibility##

##Comments##

##Saturday, 28 November 2026##

Cloudy with a risk of rain at times. Light to moderate south or southeast winds increasing moderate to fresh and gradually veering west. Top temperature of 9°C. Comments: Strong winds in places later.
